newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-Z sets issue price at PLN 9.75.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-Z sets issue price at PLN 9.75.

text.p: The Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA set the issue price of its new 2.6 million zloty issue at 9.75 zlotys per share, the company said in a statement on Friday.
It said it had signed underwriting agreements with nine institutions and that the stand-by fee was 2.3 percent.
The biggest underwriters were Creditanstalt Securities SA and Creditanstalt Investment Bank AG, which underwrote 715,000 shares each.
D.Carnegie AB underwrote 300,000 shares, the Polish Development Bank 260,000 shares and Banque Paribas from London 150,000 shares.
The brokerage of Bank Handlowy SA, BPH and Pekao SA underwrote 130,000 shares and the Penetrator brokerage 70,000 shares.
The company is offering two million shares in the large investor tranche who can subscribe for at least 20,005 shares between 12 and 13 of November.
The subscription for 600,000 shares in the retail tranche is scheduled for November 12-15.
Mostostal plans to use the proceeds from the issue to modernise its subsidiaries.
